final_query:
MATCH (sickPerson:Person {healthstatus: 'Sick'})-[:PERFORMS_VISIT]->(visit:Visit)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(place:Place)-[:PART_OF]->(:Region)-[:PART_OF]->(:Country)-[:PART_OF]->(continent:Continent)
RETURN continent.name AS ContinentName, place.type AS PlaceType, avg(duration.inSeconds(visit.duration)) AS AvgVisitDurationSeconds
ORDER BY ContinentName, PlaceType

Replace it with the function form, `avg(duration.inSeconds(visit.duration)) AS AvgVisitDurationSeconds`, keeping the existing MATCH (Person{healthstatus:'Sick'})-[:PERFORMS_VISIT]->(:Visit)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(:Place)-[:PART_OF]->(:Region)-[:PART_OF]->(:Country)-[:PART_OF]->(:Continent), the RETURN of continent.name / place.type, and the ORDER BY unchanged. Also note that if a Place can be PART_OF more than one Region (schema shows PART_OF as the only Place→Region link, without cardinality), its visits would be counted once per continent chain; only add DISTINCT handling if the question requires de-duplicated visits.
